description: The post-Draft workflow's example set (US-ME08, F5), in the marketingskills evals.json shape: each example's prompt, the output expected, its assertions, and its files. A deterministic assertion is checked by the unit tests (src/tests/test_examples.py) against the synthetic kit in files/mandu and the code in files/code; a judged assertion waits for US-ME16's re-run on every Instructions change.

assertion_kinds.deterministic: check is one of: passes; blocked_by (rule: a finding's rule, or the start of one); warns (rule); cites_angle (angle); hook_frozen; lint_passes
assertion_kinds.judged: text is a statement a reviewer, or a model at US-ME16, judges true or false of the agent's Draft

evals.prompt: Prepare the Draft for day 3 of window 1 (P03 / AB-2 leg A, primary YouTube Shorts) from the brief.
evals.expected_output: A Draft that passes every check: the frozen Hook opens the video and every caption, both platforms carry identical text, the one behavioral claim shows the code that supports it, and the item cites Angle P03, its sourced pain, signal, and kill criterion.

assertions.text: The captions read as calm and plain, in the brand's voice, with no hype.
The hook beat's visual action, spoken line, and on-screen text do not repeat each other.

evals.prompt: Prepare the Draft for day 1 of window 1 (P01 / AB-1 leg A, primary TikTok) from the brief.
evals.expected_output: A Draft that passes every check and cites Angle P01, with a claim located in the code at the commit read.

assertions.text: Every behavioral claim the copy makes appears under Claims.

evals.prompt: Prepare the Draft for day 3; the candidate below put a banned word in its caption.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft and names the banned-word rule; it never reaches the Review Queue.

assertions.text: A good Draft states the mechanic plainly without bro-fitness words.

evals.prompt: Prepare the Draft for day 3; the candidate below claims a number of people who use the app.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft for invented proof: the product has no users, and a Draft leaves [NEED: source] rather than filling a number in.

assertions.text: A good Draft lets the demo be the only proof.

evals.prompt: Prepare the Draft for day 3; the candidate below names a competitor.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft, naming the competitor and the research file that names it.

assertions.text: A good Draft states the product's own mechanics only.

evals.prompt: Prepare the Draft for day 3; the candidate below changed one word of the frozen Hook.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft: the Hook differs from its frozen text in ab-pairs.md, and a change to a Hook enters only as a new Angle through a package-change proposal.

assertions.text: A good Draft that thinks the Hook should change says so as a package-change proposal instead.

evals.prompt: Prepare the Draft for day 1; the candidate below states the unmeasured speed claim.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft on the checklist's benchmark line until the real-device measurement exists.

assertions.text: A good Draft shows speed only as the screen visibly shows it, with no number.

evals.prompt: Prepare the Draft for day 5 (P05), whose Angle rests on the unmeasured speed claim.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft even with no number in its copy, since its Angle depends on the claim the checklist still holds open.

evals.prompt: Prepare the Draft for day 3; the candidate below carries six hashtags.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft on TikTok's hashtag limit from config/platforms.json.

assertions.text: A good Draft uses at most the one hashtag the kit's drafts use.

evals.prompt: Prepare the Draft for day 3; the candidate below repeats another Angle's Hook in its caption.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft: a Hook belongs to exactly one Angle.

evals.prompt: Prepare the Draft for day 3; the candidate below cites code lines that do not show its claim.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft: the cited lines at the commit read do not contain the quoted code.

evals.prompt: Prepare the Draft for day 8 (P01 / AB-1 leg B) after day 1's Draft, changing only the Hook; the candidate below also reworded the second caption line.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft: A/B legs differ only in the Hook.

evals.prompt: Prepare the Draft for day 3; the candidate below opens a line with a stock AI phrase.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft, naming the stock phrase.

evals.prompt: Prepare the Draft for day 3; the candidate below adds an urgency line.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft for fake scarcity.

evals.prompt: Prepare the Draft for day 3; the candidate below has a first-person on-screen line in a screen-record-only Angle.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft: a first-person line needs the founder on camera, which the Angle's format does not have.

evals.prompt: Prepare the Draft for day 3; the candidate below runs one caption sentence long.
evals.expected_output: The Draft passes, with long-sentence warnings shown to the Founder; a warning never blocks.
